<!--
A published article is justified where a manuscript is set flush left, and
apaquarto-pdf was setting journal mode ragged right like the rest. The
preamble asks for RaggedRight, which suits the other three modes, so journal
mode turns it off again with ragged2e's justifying.

The other half of this is that justification must not reach into a table. In
typst `set par` applies inside a table as it does everywhere, so a cell long
enough to wrap was justified too and a column the writer asked to be left
aligned came out stretched to the column edge. APA sets no table that way.

The body paragraph below is long enough to wrap several times, and the table
has a left aligned column with a cell long enough to wrap in it.
-->

# Method

The first paragraph of the body, written long enough that it wraps over
several lines, because a paragraph of one line is justified and ragged alike
and would show nothing at all. It runs on for a while so that the lines in
between the first and the last have to be set one way or the other, and an
eye or a measurement can tell which.

| Scale | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| Ratio | A scale with a true zero, where it is meaningful to say that one value is twice another. |
| Ordinal | A scale that ranks. |
